title: Data Seed Job Compiler
description: Compiles database seed jobs. Enforces: seed command exists and is executable, job validates, idempotency contract declared, target env allowlist excludes production, all DB config refs resolve.

error_codes.DS001: data-seed-spec.json missing — required: name, command, targetEnvironments[]
error_codes.DS002: Seed command path not found in declared runtime paths
error_codes.DS003: Idempotency contract not declared — running seed twice may cause duplicate-key errors
error_codes.DS004: Production environment in targetEnvironments without explicit productionOverride flag
error_codes.DS005: DB or app config reference not declared in env schema or secrets
